summary: Amarc Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release as Exhibit 99.1. However, the filing text is largely composed of binary image data and administrative header information with no substantive disclosure of a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The document appears to be a routine foreign private issuer report (Form 6-K) that does not announce any specific corporate event. As a result, the filing does not meet the criteria for classification as a special situation.
